You will begin the return journey along the rivers of the Amazon basin. On the way to Rurrenabaque, stop for a short walk up a hill. From the viewpoint you may see macaws, known locally as guacamayas, which nest on the cliffs along the Tuichi River.

On arrival in Rurrenabaque, transfer to the airport. The flight from Rurrenabaque to La Paz is paid for separately. On arrival in La Paz, you will be taken to your hotel.

Included: one night at La Casona Hotel Boutique or a hotel of the same category, boat transport, the included walks, a local guide and transfers. Meals: breakfast.
Pedestrians in a square in front of a stone church in La Paz, Bolivia
La Paz: a busy square with a church tower and city buildings
La Paz – Copacabana – Island of the Sun – La Paz

At 08:00, set off across the Altiplano towards Lake Titicaca. After about two hours you will reach the Strait of Tiquina, which you will cross on a local ferry alongside residents.

Continue to Copacabana, with views of the lake’s larger and smaller basins along the way. You are due to arrive at the port at around 11:30.

From Copacabana, take a boat to the Island of the Sun. In the south of the island, visit Pilko Kaina Palace, an archaeological complex associated with the Incas. Continue to Yumani, the Great Inca Stairway and the Fountain of the Three Waters. According to tradition, the fountain’s water grants long life. There is time to take photographs and enjoy views of the Andes across the lake.

Back in Copacabana, visit the shrine of Our Lady of Candelaria, an important pilgrimage site, then walk through town and browse the craft shops. Return to La Paz at around 21:00.

Included: one night at La Casona Hotel Boutique or a hotel of the same category, private round-trip transfers between La Paz and Copacabana, a shared sightseeing boat, a bilingual guide and admission tickets. Meals: breakfast and lunch.
